text:
sam: Heads-up — release v2.4.0 blocked. frontend-e2e job failing during npm install: integrity checksum failed for @redwood/webapp tarball from internal registry (verdaccio). deploy-bot paused the rollout.

deploy-bot: [automated] Release v2.4.0 - paused due to failing preflight checks (frontend-e2e).

jen: logs show npm ERR! code EINTEGRITY and `sha512` mismatch. snippet: ```npm ERR! sha512-xyz wanted sha512-AAA got sha512-BBB```

liam: did we have any registry writes earlier? there was a rollback of webapp earlier today, could be a publish race.

tara: i can try to re-publish the tarball under a temporary tag and point the e2e to it. prefer not to bump the release version if avoidable.

maria: the registry sometimes serves incomplete uploads if a storage node failed mid-publish. quick check: `curl -I https://registry.internal/@redwood/webapp/-/webapp-2.4.0.tgz` and compare Content-Length to the expected size.

sam: i see Content-Length: 0 in the e2e logs for that tarball. can someone fetch and check locally?

liam: running fetch now: `curl -sSL https://registry.internal/@redwood/webapp/-/webapp-2.4.0.tgz -o /tmp/webapp.tgz && sha512sum /tmp/webapp.tgz` -> output is an empty file checksum (d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e).

tara: ok i'm republishing from ci-builder host: `npm publish --registry https://registry.internal` (using the same build artifact).

devops-bot: scheduled artifact re-publish job #4217 (runner: ci-rebuilder-2).

jen: also clear npm cache on the e2e runner: `npm cache clean --force` — last time a stale cached tarball masked the fix.

liam: good call. i'm restarting the e2e job with no-cache and cleared workspace.

tara: publish finished, tarball size 3.2MB, local sha512 matches expected. i'm tagging the publish `ci-fix` and kicking the pipeline.

sam: re-run kicked off. e2e job is running...

deploy-bot: [automated] preflight checks re-run for v2.4.0.

jen: first shard passed, other shards starting, looks green so far.

liam: e2e shards: 5/5 green. flake in a unrelated test retried and passed.

sam: OK, resume canary. liam please resume rollout. :thumbsup:

liam: resuming canary: 5% -> 20% traffic phased.

maria: opened INF-312 to add registry integrity alerts and to fail publishes that produce zero-length objects. assigning to infra team.

sam: thanks everyone. marking blocked -> resolved.

jen: note — follow-up: add npm pre-publish checksum verification in CI job to avoid silent bad uploads. :+1:
